sentences.en: For a man of seventy, he still has surprising vigour.
sentences.zh: 以七十岁的年纪来看，他仍然精力惊人。

sentences.en: It's not surprising that he be proud of his son.
sentences.zh: 他为儿子感到自豪并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: It is surprising how little she knows of the world.
sentences.zh: 她对这个世界了解之少真是令人吃惊。

senses.zh: 使惊奇；意外发现（surprise的ing形式）
